feedback:
Well, here we are in a bathroom.

You smell a wretched smell, and follow it to a toilet. The toilet is white. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it?

There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, there is no door.
